description:
Create a job request

Books a field-operations job — the work order that enters the dispatch & scheduling pipeline. Send the customer's UUID plus requested `job_dates` (date + morning/afternoon/evening periods, ideally offered from GET /job-requests/booking-windows), optional `job_type_id` (service catalog), `skill_ids` (required technician qualifications) and a free-text description. Quoting, technician/crew assignment and completion then advance the work order through the business's workflow.

customer_id.description: UUID of an existing customer of this business to book the job for. Required.

description.description: Free-text description of the work requested. Optional; max 2000 chars.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key making retries safe: a repeat send with the same key returns the original booking instead of creating a duplicate (sent as the Idempotency-Key header)

job_dates.description: Requested date(s) + period(s) the customer wants the job. At least one, up to 12.

periods.description: One or more time-of-day periods requested on this date. At least one, up to 3.

business_view.description: Business-local time ranges the period maps to (echoed from booking-windows). Optional.

end_minute.description: Range end as minutes since midnight (0–1440), business-local.

period.description: Time-of-day period this range belongs to.

start_minute.description: Range start as minutes since midnight (0–1440), business-local.

period.description: Time-of-day period the customer requested. Required.

job_type_id.description: UUID of the job type to classify this job. Optional; null leaves the job unclassified.

priority.description:
Scheduling priority. Optional; omitted bookings receive the business's
default_priority setting (assignment settings, default p2). p0=emergency
(interrupt-driven insert), p1=top (displaced only by p0), p2=standard,
p3=deferrable (first candidate for displacement).

skill_ids.description: UUIDs of the skills the customer desires for this job. Optional; up to 20.

sla_deadline.description:
SLA deadline (business-local naive datetime, e.g. "2030-06-14T17:00:00").
Optional; ONLY valid together with priority=p1 — arms the auto-escalation
clock (the job escalates to p0 as breach risk crosses the business's
safety buffer). Must be in the future.

x_timezone.description: Customer IANA timezone (sent as the X-Timezone header)
